images.title: The craft table in eight pictures
images.purpose: Give a one-glance map of the chapter: eight pictures, one for each big idea (weaving, regular shapes, tessellation, triangles, four-sided shapes, circles, cubes, solids), as a revision cue.
images.composition: Eight equal tiles in two rows of four, each with one simple shape drawing above a one or two word label, under the chapter title.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. HEADING at the top: Shapes and Patterns, bold dark #1F2937 sans-serif, 44 px, centred at (728,85). EIGHT TILES in 2 rows of 4, each a rounded rectangle 300 by 280 px with a grey #6B7280 outline (4 px) and no fill; row 1 tiles span y 150 to 430 and x 70 to 370, 420 to 720, 770 to 1070 and 1120 to 1420; row 2 tiles span y 480 to 760 and the same x ranges. Under each drawing, inside the tile, one label in bold dark 30 px, centred on the tile's middle x, at y 400 in row 1 and y 730 in row 2. All shapes have a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px). TILE 1 (row 1, first): a woven mat drawn as exactly 16 squares in 4 rows of 4, every square 48 by 48 px, from (124,172) to (316,364), alternating blue #0072B2 and amber #E69F00 like a checkerboard with the top left square blue; label Weaving. TILE 2: exactly 1 regular hexagon with side 90 px, flat top and bottom, centre (570,285), corners (660,285), (615,363), (525,363), (480,285), (525,207), (615,207), filled blue #0072B2; label Regular shapes. TILE 3: exactly 3 regular hexagons with side 55 px, pointy top, touching edge to edge round one point (920,272) with no gap and no overlap, centres at (872,245), (968,245) and (920,327), filled blue #0072B2, amber #E69F00 and reddish purple #CC79A7 in that order, and one small dark dot of 10 px at the meeting point (920,272); label Tessellation. TILE 4: exactly 1 triangle with 3 equal sides, corners (1270,190), (1185,337) and (1355,337), filled amber #E69F00; label Triangles. TILE 5 (row 2, first): exactly 1 kite with corners (220,505) top, (150,585) left, (220,705) bottom and (290,585) right, filled blue #0072B2, its 2 upper sides about 106 px and its 2 lower sides about 139 px; label Four-sided shapes. TILE 6: exactly 1 circle of radius 90 px centred at (570,600), outline dark 4 px, no fill; exactly 2 thin dark lines through the centre, one horizontal from (480,600) to (660,600) and one from (492,645) to (648,555); the four ends joined by 4 straight sides to make a rectangle, shaded blue #0072B2 at 30 percent; label Circles. TILE 7: exactly 1 cube drawn in three faces, top face corners (920,510), (1007,560), (920,610), (833,560) amber #E69F00, left face corners (833,560), (920,610), (920,710), (833,660) blue #0072B2, right face corners (920,610), (1007,560), (1007,660), (920,710) green #009E73; label Cubes. TILE 8: exactly 1 long box drawn in three faces, front face corners (1190,580), (1350,580), (1350,670), (1190,670) blue #0072B2, top face corners (1190,580), (1230,545), (1390,545), (1350,580) amber #E69F00, right face corners (1350,580), (1390,545), (1390,635), (1350,670) reddish purple #CC79A7; label Solids. No other text, no numbers, no marks. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, tiles or faces that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
any number written on an angle, and any angle-measuring tool, anywhere in the frame
any gap or overlap between the three hexagons of the tessellation tile
tiles in a different order, or more or fewer than eight tiles
images.takeaway: The chapter's eight ideas on one table: weaving, regular shapes, tessellation, triangles, four-sided shapes, circles, cubes and solids.
images.description: Eight tiles with simple drawings: a woven checkerboard mat, a regular hexagon, three hexagons meeting at a point, a triangle, a kite, a circle with two diameters and a rectangle, a cube and a box.
images.context: Concept image for the Chapter Revision summary. It follows the idea of the craft table of this chapter and uses one picture per idea; no figure of the book is copied.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the child to say one fact for each tile before reading the summary lines.

image_decisions.why: One picture per big idea gives the revision a map to tick through, and the text summary then has something to point at.
